description: Verifies a list of addresses as one SMTPing bulk job (deduplicated, up to 100,000). Waits up to 120 seconds; if the job is still running, returns a job_id to pass to get_bulk_job later. Costs 1 credit per unique address.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for results. Default 120. Use 0 to only start the job.

name: verify_list
title: Verify a list of email addresses
